neper.notes: The baseline: the v2 outlined combo box in the same cells. Open lists are on neper/combo_box_lists.png (run the app with an argument, `combo_box.exe lists`); the list opens fading, so one frame shows it part way.

windows.notes: Frame measured from the Options dialog (capture 00b, 150 %): #FDFDFD face, 1 px #D2D2D2 border, radius 4, 21 tall (30 px at 150 %), a thin grey chevron 8 wide centred 8.7 from the right edge, text 2.5 in. The drop-down list (windows/combo_box_lists.png) is the DevExpress popup of captures 00c and IC1: white, rows 15 tall, the lit row #0078D7 under white text, no motion, 8 rows then a scrolling viewport. Same drawing under control.select (and so the picker popup) and under the date edit's head; the editable combo keeps its editor, Up/Down/Enter/Escape and filtering unchanged.
gaps: Hover (3 % face tint), open and focused (the accent #298DD9 1.33 px border of the pilot button), pressed, drop button hot (black chevron), disabled and read-only colours are guesses: no capture shows those states of this control
Text is 11.2 px Segoe UI; in capture 00b the text is about 3 % narrower (11 px?)
The drop-down's frame is a uniform 1 px #BCBCBC with a 1 x 2 shadow: capture 00c shows light top and left edges and a dark #696969 right and bottom edge, which one uniform border cannot draw
Row height is 15 (capture IC1, 22.4 px at 150 %); capture 00c measures 14 (21 px at 150 %)
No dotted focus rectangle on the lit row (capture IC1 has one)
Row under the pointer wins over the chosen one (as DevExpress); the chevron does not flip when open (native)
The scrollbar in a long list is the generic thumb of widget.scroll_view, not the Windows scroll bar (see scroll_bar)
DropDownRows (10 in some v3 filter combos) is not an option: the viewport is 8 rows

The main-form Mode combo (capture 00c: square flat frame, raised grey drop button with a black triangle) and the in-grid editor of IC1 (grey list, blue frame, blue drop button) use other v3 styles and are not drawn
Dark and high-contrast palettes: Neper colours with Windows metrics (the harness's windows-dark sheet renders with the dark Windows tokens, unreviewed)

image_combo_box.gap: No per-item image in Neper's combo box rows; control.image_select adds it for the Windows look and is the plain select under the others

neper.notes: The baseline: control.select (no pictures: control.image_select falls back to it under the other looks).

windows.notes: control.image_select: the combo box's frame and drop-down with a 16 px picture leading the head's value and every row (rows 18 tall with a picture). Drawn glyphs stand in for the image list's bitmaps.
gaps: No v3 capture shows a picture in an image combo box (capture IC1's list has none): the 16 px picture, its 3 px gap to the text and the 18 px row height are guesses
Frame, chevron and drop-down colours are those of the combo box, with its guessed states (hover, open, focused, disabled)
The head is at least 112 wide, not the DFM's 121 (Width = 121 in batch_update); there is no width option
The in-grid editor style of capture IC1 (grey list, blue frame and drop button) is not drawn
Nothing chosen shows the label muted; v3 shows an empty edit
Keyboard: the open list has no Up/Down/Enter handling (control.select has none either)

neper.notes: The baseline: overlay.date_picker_with with a typed field (stray carets are the harness's focus slot, as in the other sheets).

windows.notes: A typed date: the combo box's frame (edit and drop button, 120 wide) with the calendar docked against it in a white panel with a grey edge and a hard shadow, Today and Clear as Windows buttons below the days. The typed edit keeps its parsing (Enter commits, the form reformats on blur).
gaps: No capture of the DevExpress calendar drop-down exists: the panel is the Neper calendar (rounded Primary disc for the chosen day, grey hover disc, chevron month arrows, Mo Tu We header) in Windows colours, not the DX layout
DateButtons in the DFM are Clear, Now and Today (ckDateTime): only Today and Clear are drawn, no time part, no Now
Panel edge, shadow and padding are guesses (those of the combo box's list)
Hover, focused and drop button states are the combo box's guessed ones
Read-only date edits (deck properties: Properties.EditProperties.ReadOnly) and the clear (x) button are not drawn
The date format hint and invalid message of overlay.date_entry keep the Neper look

neper.notes: The baseline: the v2 list box (rounded frame, check on the chosen row).

windows.notes: Framed viewport with the combo box's face and border (#FDFDFD, #D2D2D2, radius 4) and the drop-down's rows (15 tall, chosen row #0078D7 under white text), scrolling past its rows. v3 has no TListBox or TcxListBox (only TcxCheckListBox): this is derived from the combo box evidence, not a capture of a list box.
gaps: No v3 list box exists to measure: frame, row height 15 and selection colour are taken from the combo box and its drop-down
No hover effect (DevExpress list boxes have none without hot tracking); the Hover sheet cell is therefore unchanged
No dotted focus rectangle on the current row and no focus frame: the Windows tokens draw no focus ring
control.list_box has no disabled option, so there is no disabled cell
The scrollbar is the generic thumb of widget.scroll_view, not the Windows scroll bar (see scroll_bar)
TcxCheckListBox (print_proxies) is control.multi_select_list and keeps its look (see check_list_box)
